stages.name: refine
stages.findings: All required Ready dimensions are satisfied after adding explicit Product Change scope, BR citations, E2E selection details, quality expectations, risks and red lines. Issue remains status:in-progress because lifecycle has no valid rollback transition from implementation to ready.

stages.name: propose
stages.findings: Plan revision addressed round-one findings and received independent approval from gpt-6-astra. One Transport-function wording detail will be resolved during implementation.

stages.name: implement
stages.findings: Implementation remains underway. Project time periods support persistence, API/browser management and audience-specific document visibility; Complete blocks operational writes and reopening restores them. Period-based Crew/Transport generation creates one linked function per selected period and requested kind. Moving a period updates linked function ranges and shift offsets transactionally; invalid ranges roll back and unlinked functions remain unchanged. Project detail editing persists contact-person selection, project type, team, and an eligible Admin/Office account manager. The account manager directory is role-filtered, assignments are revalidated on create/update, and the detail E2E reloads the persisted name. Project-number allocation supports transactional automatic/custom assignment, deterministic backfill, duplicate rejection, concurrency and browser reload persistence; seed and request-conversion paths assign unique values. The detail screen now creates and displays project note and file-context records, and the E2E checks persistence after reload. Full Web, frontend, solution and E2E suites have passed locally. Remote CI for d5d3a0f passed all required checks. Remaining commercial overrides, task/file capability gaps, equipment-group propagation, remaining planned UI/E2E coverage and the Done gate remain unfinished.

findings: Added explicit tasks and scenarios for period designation and linked/unlinked propagation.
Added module ownership and failure-handling details for Projects, Contacts, Commercial, Documents, Crew, Transport and Warehouse boundaries.
Added API and browser coverage for Complete/reopen, status-dependent visibility, document rendering, selected cancellation actions, synthetic data and Area=projects selection metadata.
Prior gaps are covered with explicit accepted-scope tasks, module boundaries, transaction behavior, failure scenarios and per-PR E2E selection metadata.
Align whether Transport function generation applies to every selected period during implementation; this wording detail does not block the plan.

The committed number allocation amendment matches the previously reviewed plan; custom and generated numbers share a transaction-scoped lock, the migration backfills deterministically, and configurable start values remain tracked by #416.

reviews.findings: The project detail previously had no account manager assignment. The approved plan's Admin/Office eligibility is enforced in the Projects module using a Workspace identity directory, checked on writes, and exposed through an eligible-user endpoint. The browser journey selects and reloads a manager. The process ledger now records the rule to validate role-based assignments at the write boundary.

rerunChecks.fullFrontendSuite: passed (52 passed, 0 failed; format, lint, typecheck, build, architecture check, audit)
rerunChecks.remoteCiForPreviousCommit: passed all required checks on d5d3a0f

reviews.findings: The first frontend test exposed that a React submit event's currentTarget must be captured before awaiting a network request; the form element is now retained explicitly. The first E2E attempt used Spanish labels against the English browser locale; the journey now uses the labels from the configured locale. Aspire E2E recreates node_modules with npm ci, so frontend checks must run after the E2E runner completes in a shared worktree.

corrections.requestedChanges: Complete plan traceability and failure coverage; fix PostgreSQL migration NULL type inference reported by both integration and E2E CI jobs.

rerunChecks.productshapeCitations: passed after expanded citations (145 documents, 531 current citations)

corrections.requestedChanges: Exercise automatic and custom project numbers, duplicate rejection, concurrent creation, deterministic populated-database backfill, generated API contract, browser edit persistence, seed creation and request conversion.
corrections.findings: The first Aspire run exposed two project-creation paths outside the interactive workflow: demo seed and incoming-request conversion. Both now use explicit/allocated unique numbers. The full Web suite then exposed retained per-database Npgsql pools exhausting PostgreSQL connections; RaccordApi now clears only its own pool on disposal, and the suite passed with normal parallelism.
